description: https://twitter.com/HobbiesCards  FEDNOW has named the list of the first 57 approved providers and ancillaries for the FEDNOW system. There are NO CRYPTO companies listed as providers. Volante and Metalicus have been removed!  XRP and XLM holders will anxiously await Jerome Powell and the FED to release their minutes from the last FOMC meeting.   PEPE and PSYOP trending hotter than XRP, but who cares about trending when price is what pays the bills...  STELLAR USDC supported by Coinbase, is this good for XLM holders?  another year of no fees for Moneygram ramps using Stellar  XRP in a volatile price zone at the moment.  Bitmart sale on XRP June 21st n 22nd!!!  Stellar XLM partner WYRE is shutting down citing poor market conditions.  XLM faces heavy downward trends in volume and the price reflects it.   XRP falls below 50 cents fast with some harsh news providing the negative stimulus.   Big week for XRP as Hinman docs are set to be released. Don't forget CPI and rate hike decision from Jerome Powell and the FED.   XLM appears not only to be a laggard in the crypto market, but XLM also is very sensitive to news events.   SEC takes on Binance and Coinbase! XRP takes a hit, while Solana, Cardano, and Polygon take an even bigger hit being delisted by Robinhood.  The FED says 600+ BPS, so get ready for it. Pepe gets another listing here shortly.  XRP as a store of value, looking more and more like a possibility.   Torres says Hinman docs are to be made public. JUNE 13TH is the date!  Bakkt delists the following citing regulatory concerns aka unregistered securities. visual.context: Discussion/reporting of an article about FedNow and blockchain services; the visible text presents the integration as a claim and includes a qualification that the name was removed.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed relationship connects a claimed government-payment-service integration with conversion of cash to stablecoins, creating a conditional need to examine whether the stated support or integration relationship is accurately represented.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish that the integration occurred, that FedNow endorsed the network, that any transaction took place, or that viewers were asked to send money or provide information.

visual_context_notes.observation: The displayed article headline states that the Federal Reserve's FedNow service attracts U.S. firms and excludes blockchain companies.
The article visibly qualifies the blockchain integration discussion by stating that the network's name was removed from the list after the announcement.

annotation.contextual_rationale: The video focuses on cryptocurrency payment narratives surrounding FedNow and discusses a reported claim that a blockchain network would convert cash to stablecoins through the service, followed by the reported removal of that network from the relevant list. The speaker frames these statements as news and criticism of channels promoting FedNow or blockchain integration claims, rather than clearly presenting the reported integration as his own offer. The supplied records do not show a request for viewers to send money, provide credentials, or participate in a crypto transaction, and the description instead includes an entertainment disclaimer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The best-grounded supplied Scam subtype is token purchase, appreciation or holding returns because the primary records discuss token price performance and present XRP as a possible store of value. The evidence supports an investment-related token context, but does not establish a completed purchase, guaranteed appreciation, or a specific return.

evidence.observation: The speaker characterizes FedNow as competing with cryptocurrency and blockchain payments rather than enabling them.
